text: Single-file Python vault.py using cryptography package
Master password read from VAULT_MASTER_KEY env var, never from a CLI argument
Fernet encryption with key derived via PBKDF2HMAC SHA-256, 200,000 iterations
Random 16-byte salt stored in vault file header
Keys must match [a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,64}; invalid keys rejected with exit 1
Keys stored lowercase (case-insensitive lookup)
Values at most 4096 bytes UTF-8; larger rejected with exit 1
--ttl DAYS option, default 90 days
Expiry stored as ISO-8601
Commands set, get, list, delete, rotate, audit exist
get prints only the value to stdout
get exits 3 for expired secret and never prints the expired value
list shows value[:4] followed by *** and never the full value
rotate exits 1 if key does not exist
rotate re-sets value of existing key (exit 0)
audit appends to ~/.vault/audit.log
audit command shows last 20 lines of audit log
3 wrong passwords create a .lockout file; exit 2
Wrong password exits 2
Values never written to audit log
Values never written to stderr
vault.enc has mode 600
~/.vault/ has mode 700
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 user error (e.g. missing key, missing env), 2 auth/lockout, 3 expired
delete removes key; deleting missing key is user error exit 1
